dataset: Microsoft FinOps Toolkit demo FOCUS dataset
currency: USD, as identified in prior dataset inspection; verify BillingCurrency
candidate_rule: Identifiable resource groups with positive billed spend at or above the 90th percentile of positive spend across identifiable resource groups.
limitations: High spend alone does not prove waste or inefficiency.
The dataset does not provide sufficient utilization, workload, criticality or SLA evidence to approve downsizing automatically.
Savings scenarios are hypothetical and are not realized savings.
Any proposed change requires owner review, usage evidence, business criticality checks and SLA/performance validation.
Negative billing entries are reported separately and not assumed to be refunds or errors.
